tspan.tspan: emotion2vec+ large architecture (tensor shapes for one 4 s clip at 16 kHz, batch = 1)
Parameters (measured in model.pt): CNN 4.21 M · projection 0.53 M · positional conv 6.23 M · Transformer 151.2 M · extra tokens + ALiBi 0.01 M · classifier 0.009 M; total 162.1 M (0.65 GB in fp32)
model.pt (1.95 GB) = weights 0.65 GB + Adam optimizer state 1.30 GB + training config. FunASR also builds a 1.9 M pre-training decoder: not in model.pt, not used for inference.
Sources: config.yaml, the model.pt state dict, FunASR 1.4.16 funasr/models/emotion2vec/; shapes measured with forward hooks.
